blocks.text: KATHMANDU — Two helicopters collided and crashed while attempting to land in Nepal’s Everest region on Tuesday, killing a foreign national and injuring another person, police told AFP. Small helicopters are widely used in the Himalayan nation to transport tourists, climbers and supplies, as well as to carry out emergency evacuations. READ: Six dead in Nepal tourist helicopter crash The country’s challenging terrain and rapidly changing weather conditions make aviation operations particularly hazardous.
